name: Mental Breakdown Germany 2018
information:
The idea for this competition comes from [Mental Breakdown 2016](https://www.cubingusa.com/MentalBreakdown2016/) held in Irvine, CA. Mental Breakdown Germany 2018 is the second episode of Mental Breakdown competitions in Germany. 


The entrance fee for competitors is 25 Euro for the competition with pre-payment. Since all official events are spread on both competition days, every registration is automatically valid for both days.
